launch2Creator_launch2BootstrapRequired.en: Your account is still being set up. Try again later.
launch2Creator_launch2BootstrapRequired.zh: 账号还在初始化，稍后再试。

launch2Creator_launch2Build10.en: Fixed by the platform template; can't be changed.
launch2Creator_launch2Build10.zh: 由平台模板固定，不能修改。

launch2Creator_launch2Build11.en: The platform hasn't set a buyback recipient address yet, so you can't submit right now.
launch2Creator_launch2Build11.zh: 平台还没有配置回购收币地址，暂时不能提交。

launch2Creator_launch2CreateBody.en: What you've entered won't be saved.
launch2Creator_launch2CreateBody.zh: 已填写的内容不会保存。

launch2Creator_launch2CreateIf.en: Only links starting with https:// are supported
launch2Creator_launch2CreateIf.zh: 只支持 https:// 开头的链接

launch2Creator_launch2CreateLaunch2Creat.en: To bind a community, the community owner does it under Community management → Bind token.
launch2Creator_launch2CreateLaunch2Creat.zh: 要绑定社区，请由社区群主在社区侧「社区管理 → 绑定代币」里操作。

launch2Creator_launch2CreateLaunch2Creat.en: The project's X / Telegram / website / Discord, all optional; reviewers and users will see them.
launch2Creator_launch2CreateLaunch2Creat.zh: 项目的 X / Telegram / 官网 / Discord，都可不填；审核与用户都会看到。

launch2Creator_launch2CreateLaunch2Creat.en: A launch needs a square avatar
launch2Creator_launch2CreateLaunch2Creat.zh: 发射需要一张方形头像

launch2Creator_launch2CreateLaunch2Creat.en: A launch needs an NFT image
launch2Creator_launch2CreateLaunch2Creat.zh: 发射需要一张 NFT 图

launch2Creator_launch2CreateLaunch2Creat.en: Choose a mint start time first.
launch2Creator_launch2CreateLaunch2Creat.zh: 请先选择铸造开始时间。

launch2Creator_launch2CreateLaunch2Creat.en: The mint start time is too early: the platform needs at least {leadLabel} of lead time, earliest {localTimestampLabel}. Choose again.
launch2Creator_launch2CreateLaunch2Creat.zh: 铸造开始时间太早：平台要求至少提前 {leadLabel}，最早 {localTimestampLabel}，请重新选择。

launch2Creator_launch2CreateLaunch2SaleS.en: The platform sets the earliest time; too early gets sent back.
launch2Creator_launch2CreateLaunch2SaleS.zh: 最早可选时间由平台决定，太早会被退回。

launch2Creator_launch2CreateLaunch2SaleS.en: Minting must start at least {leadLabel} from now, earliest {localTimestampLabel}.
launch2Creator_launch2CreateLaunch2SaleS.zh: 平台要求至少提前 {leadLabel}开始铸造，最早 {localTimestampLabel}。

launch2Creator_launch2CreateNote.zh: 方形图片，上传前可裁剪

launch2Creator_launch2DeploymentLaunch2D.zh: 已激活，你是这个项目的项目方。

launch2Creator_launch2DeploymentLaunch2D.en: The link has no valid project or job ID.
launch2Creator_launch2DeploymentLaunch2D.zh: 链接里没有有效的项目或任务编号。

launch2Creator_launch2DeploymentLaunch2D.en: Signature verified and recorded; waiting for the platform executor to deploy. Nothing is on-chain yet.
launch2Creator_launch2DeploymentLaunch2D.zh: 已验签登记，等待平台执行器部署。这一步还没有上链。

launch2Creator_launch2DeploymentLaunch2D.en: Couldn't load the latest progress. Showing the last status; retrying automatically.
launch2Creator_launch2DeploymentLaunch2D.zh: 最新进度没有读到，下面是上一次读到的状态，会自动重试。

launch2Creator_launch2EntryLaunch2Create.en: Bonding curve token; moves to PancakeSwap when it fills
launch2Creator_launch2EntryLaunch2Create.zh: 联合曲线发币，打满自动上 PancakeSwap

launch2Creator_launch2EntryLaunch2Create.en: NFT presale + priority buy + public pool, graduates to the official DEX pool
launch2Creator_launch2EntryLaunch2Create.zh: NFT 预售 + 提前购 + 公开内盘，毕业进官方外盘

launch2Creator_launch2EntryLaunch2Creato.en: v2 launch (NFT presale + official DEX pool)
launch2Creator_launch2EntryLaunch2Creato.zh: v2 发射（NFT 预售 + 官方外盘）

launch2Creator_launch2IdempotencyConflic.en: This submission differs from the last one. Sign again.
launch2Creator_launch2IdempotencyConflic.zh: 这次提交和上一次内容不同，请重新签名。

launch2Creator_launch2InvalidData.en: The server didn't accept these details. Most often the mint start time is too early and leaves no time to deploy and activate. Move it later and submit again.
launch2Creator_launch2InvalidData.zh: 服务端没有接受这份资料。最常见的原因是铸造开始时间太早，需要给部署和激活留出时间，往后调整后再提交。

launch2Creator_launch2Launch2ConfigVersi.en: Another project in your wallet already used this configuration version. Edit the details and save a new version.
launch2Creator_launch2Launch2ConfigVersi.zh: 这一版配置的版本号已被你钱包的另一个项目用过，请修改资料重新保存一版。

launch2Creator_launch2Launch2FixedRecipi.en: Buyback recipient address not configured yet
launch2Creator_launch2Launch2FixedRecipi.zh: 回购收币地址暂未配置

launch2Creator_launch2Launch2FixedRecipi.en: Buyback recipient address {value}, fixed by the platform, can't be changed
launch2Creator_launch2Launch2FixedRecipi.zh: 回购收币地址 {value}，平台固定，不可修改

launch2Creator_launch2Launch2NftImageHel.en: Shown in wallets as the project NFT image
launch2Creator_launch2Launch2NftImageHel.zh: 将作为项目 NFT 图片显示在钱包里

launch2Creator_launch2Launch2RecipientFi.en: The buyback recipient address must be the platform's fixed address. This version uses another one. Edit the details and save a new version (needs review again).
launch2Creator_launch2Launch2RecipientFi.zh: 回购收币地址必须是平台固定地址。这一版配置用的是其他地址，请修改资料重新保存一版（需要重新审核）。

launch2Creator_launch2Launch2RecipientUn.en: The platform's buyback recipient address isn't configured, so you can't save or sign right now. Try again later.
launch2Creator_launch2Launch2RecipientUn.zh: 平台回购收币地址暂未配置，暂时不能保存或签名，稍后再试。

launch2Creator_launch2LoopNotice2.en: {configuration} didn't pass review ({localTimestampLabel}). Edit it and submit again.
launch2Creator_launch2LoopNotice2.zh: {localTimestampLabel} {configuration}未通过审核，修改后可以重新提交。

launch2Creator_launch2NotFound.en: Couldn't find this project. It may not belong to this account.
launch2Creator_launch2NotFound.zh: 找不到这个项目，它可能不属于当前账号。

launch2Creator_launch2PermissionDenied.en: This account can't do this step.
launch2Creator_launch2PermissionDenied.zh: 当前账号不能执行这一步。

launch2Creator_launch2ProjectLaunch2Proj.en: The link has no valid project ID.
launch2Creator_launch2ProjectLaunch2Proj.zh: 链接里没有有效的项目编号。

launch2Creator_launch2ProjectLaunch2Proj.en: Activated. Creating the project page; pull down to refresh.
launch2Creator_launch2ProjectLaunch2Proj.zh: 已激活，项目页生成中，下拉可刷新。

launch2Creator_launch2ProjectLaunch2Proj.en: Details saved; the launch configuration is still missing.
launch2Creator_launch2ProjectLaunch2Proj.zh: 资料已保存，还差发射配置。

launch2Creator_launch2ProjectLaunch2Proj.en: This version's buyback recipient address isn't the platform's fixed address, so it can't be signed and deployed. Saving a new version needs review again.
launch2Creator_launch2ProjectLaunch2Proj.zh: 这一版配置的回购收币地址不是平台固定地址，不能签名部署。修改资料重新保存一版后需要重新审核。
回购收币地址需要更新

launch2Creator_launch2ProjectLaunch2Proj.en: This review didn't pass. Edit and submit again.
launch2Creator_launch2ProjectLaunch2Proj.zh: 这次审核没有通过，修改后可以重新提交。

launch2Creator_launch2ProjectLaunch2Proj.en: The platform is reviewing the launch configuration. The result shows here; pull down to refresh.
launch2Creator_launch2ProjectLaunch2Proj.zh: 平台审核发射配置，结果会显示在这里，下拉可刷新。

launch2Creator_launch2ProjectLaunch2Proj.en: Submitted {localTimestampLabel}. The result shows here; pull down to refresh.
launch2Creator_launch2ProjectLaunch2Proj.zh: {localTimestampLabel} 提交，结果会显示在这里，下拉可刷新。

launch2Creator_launch2ProjectLaunch2Proj.en: Sign with your wallet and the platform will deploy and activate.
launch2Creator_launch2ProjectLaunch2Proj.zh: 用钱包签名后，平台会部署并激活。

launch2Creator_launch2ProjectLaunch2Proj.en: Approved {localTimestampLabel}. Sign with your wallet and the platform will deploy and activate.
launch2Creator_launch2ProjectLaunch2Proj.zh: {localTimestampLabel} 批准。用钱包签名后，平台会部署并激活。

launch2Creator_launch2ProjectsLaunch2Pro.en: NFT presale + official DEX pool, in one launch.
launch2Creator_launch2ProjectsLaunch2Pro.zh: NFT 预售 + 官方外盘，一次发起。

launch2Creator_launch2ProjectsSubtitle.en: Couldn't load the launch configuration. Pull to refresh or tap to retry
launch2Creator_launch2ProjectsSubtitle.zh: 发射配置暂时读不到，下拉刷新或点开重试

launch2Creator_launch2S.en: v2 launch isn't open yet. You can continue here once it opens.
launch2Creator_launch2S.zh: v2 发射暂未开放，开放后这里可以继续。

launch2Creator_launch2S2.en: The launch factory isn't available (or is computing addresses). Try again later.
launch2Creator_launch2S2.zh: 发射工厂暂时不可用（或正在计算地址），稍后再试。

launch2Creator_launch2S3.en: The configuration is waiting for platform approval. Sign after it's approved.
launch2Creator_launch2S3.zh: 配置还在等平台审批，审批通过后再签名。

launch2Creator_launch2S4.en: The signing request expired. Renew it and sign again.
launch2Creator_launch2S4.zh: 签名请求已过期，续期后重新签名。

launch2Creator_launch2S6.en: Tokens bought back go to this address. The platform fixes it; it can't be changed.
launch2Creator_launch2S6.zh: 回购买到的代币转入这个地址。地址由平台固定，不能修改。

launch2Creator_launch2SignIf.en: Preparing the signing request; the server may take a few seconds to compute addresses.
launch2Creator_launch2SignIf.zh: 正在准备签名请求，服务端计算地址可能要几秒。

launch2Creator_launch2SignLaunch2SignExp.en: The signing request expired. Renewing gets a new request that you need to sign again.
launch2Creator_launch2SignLaunch2SignExp.zh: 签名请求已过期。续期后会拿到新的请求，需要重新签名。

launch2Creator_launch2SignLaunch2SignNoW.en: No wallet available. Create or activate one in Wallet first.
launch2Creator_launch2SignLaunch2SignNoW.zh: 还没有可用的钱包，先在钱包里创建或激活一个。

launch2Creator_launch2SignLaunch2SignRef.en: The configuration or nonce changed. The signing request was refreshed; sign again.
launch2Creator_launch2SignLaunch2SignRef.zh: 配置或 nonce 已变化，已刷新签名请求，请重新签名。

launch2Creator_launch2SignSwitch.en: You cancelled the signature in your wallet. Nothing was submitted.
launch2Creator_launch2SignSwitch.zh: 你在钱包里取消了签名，没有提交任何内容。

launch2Creator_launch2SignSwitch2.en: This signing request belongs to another wallet. Switch to the project owner's wallet.
launch2Creator_launch2SignSwitch2.zh: 签名请求属于另一个钱包，请切换到项目方钱包。

launch2Creator_launch2SignSwitch3.en: The signing request is for the wrong network. Nothing was signed.
launch2Creator_launch2SignSwitch3.zh: 签名请求的网络不对，没有签名。

launch2Creator_launch2SignSwitch4.en: The embedded wallet isn't available. Sign in again and retry.
launch2Creator_launch2SignSwitch4.zh: 内嵌钱包不可用，请重新登录后再试。

launch2Creator_launch2SignSwitch5.en: The wallet didn't finish signing. Nothing was submitted.
launch2Creator_launch2SignSwitch5.zh: 钱包没有完成签名，没有提交任何内容。

launch2Creator_launch2SignText.en: This is an authorization signature and spends nothing. The platform deploys and activates once it receives it; progress is on the next page.
launch2Creator_launch2SignText.zh: 这是一次授权签名，不花费资产；平台收到后部署并激活，进度在下一页。

launch2Creator_launch2Switch.en: The signature expired. Sign and submit again.
launch2Creator_launch2Switch.zh: 签名已过期，请重新签名提交。

launch2Creator_launch2Switch10.en: The platform is processing and will retry automatically.
launch2Creator_launch2Switch10.zh: 平台处理中，会自动重试。

launch2Creator_launch2Switch11.en: The deployment didn't finish. Contact the platform.
launch2Creator_launch2Switch11.zh: 部署没有完成，请联系平台。

launch2Creator_launch2Switch2.en: The configuration was updated. Sign again.
launch2Creator_launch2Switch2.zh: 配置已更新，请重新签名。

launch2Creator_launch2Switch3.en: The configuration approval lapsed. Sign again after the platform approves.
launch2Creator_launch2Switch3.zh: 配置审批已失效，等待平台审批后重新签名。

launch2Creator_launch2Switch5.en: The wallet nonce changed. Sign again.
launch2Creator_launch2Switch5.zh: 钱包 nonce 已变化，请重新签名。

launch2Creator_launch2Switch6.en: This version is already deployed on-chain. Contact the platform.
launch2Creator_launch2Switch6.zh: 该版本已在链上部署，请联系平台。

launch2Creator_launch2Switch7.en: Too close to the mint start to activate. Change the mint start time and submit again.
launch2Creator_launch2Switch7.zh: 距铸造开始太近无法激活，修改铸造开始时间后重新提交。

launch2Creator_launch2Switch8.en: The name or ticker isn't allowed. Edit and submit again.
launch2Creator_launch2Switch8.zh: 名称 / 代码不合规，请修改后重新提交。

launch2Creator_launch2Switch9.en: The deployment check didn't match, so the project wasn't activated. Contact the platform.
launch2Creator_launch2Switch9.zh: 部署核验不一致，项目未激活，请联系平台。

launch2Creator_launch2VersionConflict.en: The details were changed elsewhere and have been reloaded. Check them and submit again.
launch2Creator_launch2VersionConflict.zh: 资料在别处被改过，已重新读取，请确认后再提交。
